t: Magnusson 72" (1830mm) box beam level constructed from anodised aluminium to provide durability for site work. The robust, highly accurate measuring tool is ideal for construction and installation tasks. Features a V-groove magnetic base which securely attaches to metal surfaces and pipes when working with plumbing, steelwork, and framework. The professional spirit level features 3 solid block vials for precise 45°, 90°, and 180° measurements, ensuring exact horizontal and vertical alignment with 0.5 mm/m accuracy. Shock-resistant rubber end caps protect the level from impacts, and an ergonomic hand grip ensures comfortable handling during extended use on building projects.
